verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost pixel-identical and fail in the same ways. In both, the SALE circles are pushed to the right edge and the letters have shrunk and dropped out of their discs: 'S' and 'L' sit at the bottom of their circles and 'A' sits on the line between two circles, so the main message can't be read. 'NEW YEAR SPECIAL' is tiny and off-centre at the top, and the decoration is copied twice across the canvas instead of being rearranged, so the hierarchy is gone.
